component.name: camonlinux
component.summary: Take photos and record videos with your webcam

description.p: A simple, modern webcam app for Linux — take photos and record videos with your webcam. Inspired by KDE's Kamoso, but written from scratch in C# with Avalonia UI and a GStreamer capture backend.

ul.li: Live preview with 25+ built-in effects plus frei0r filters
Photos (JPEG/PNG) with burst mode, self-timer and camera-shutter sound
Videos (H.264 + AAC, MKV) with mic audio, rotation, digital zoom and auto-split
Live camera controls — brightness, white balance, exposure, focus, gain, sharpness
Gallery with thumbnails, an in-app photo viewer, and batch operations
Device hot-plug detection, keyboard shortcuts, fullscreen

description.p: Initial release — photos, videos, effects, audio capture, gallery and camera controls.
